text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi of the Past
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
She's running on the Class B track again.
Wasn't she supposed to have moved up to the advanced Class A...?

text_block_list.name: Exhausted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Heard she dropped down to B again.
Her health's frail, so she couldn't take the test the other day.
...Kind of feel bad for her.”

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi of the Past
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Haa... haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—Wow, she's such a hard worker then!
Training on her own like that
means she's totally planning to retake the test!

text_block_list.name: Spe, Sky & King
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh!
Haaaaaaaahhh!!
Yaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Special, Sky, and the Second as well...
The favorites for the Satsuki Sho have arrived.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Grass Wonder is taking a break,
and El Condor Pasa announced she's taking a different route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: This year's Classic Triple Crown is definitely going to be a battle between the "Big Three"...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
âTsuru-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you're aiming for the Triple Crown,
you're entering the Satsuki Sho too, right, Tsuru-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's both do our veeeery beeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah!!
I won't loooose--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I am definitely going to!
Become an "unrivaled, absolutely strongest" Triple Crown Umamusume--!!
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi! Let's get today's training started!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
Tsuyoshi is all ready too!

Soon comes the stage of the "Triple Crown"—
The Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown,
is just around the corner.

"For that reason, I decided to occasionally mix high-intensity workouts into her training.
I'd like to think she can handle it now, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...!!
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, I'm going to check the heat in your legs.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, Trainer-san.
Are we... done for today?"

My mind raced desperately.
How were Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's legs holding up?
Could she continue, or did she need a medical examination?

In the first place, what is the cause of this fever?
Can't we prevent it instead of merely treating it?

“—If no amount of thinking
can produce the right answer with this brain of mine...”

Next time, we just need to find a way to unleash it!
—Borrowing someone else's brain is an option too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
What kind of meet-and-greet is this...?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Old Man
text_block_list.text: Hello there~ Good afternoon~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
Hello~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is our first time meeting, right?!
Who might you be?!
choice_data_list: Starting today, this person will be your personal physician!
Starting today, this person will be your personal physician!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Exclusive!?
—A personal physician. The hurdles to finding one were exceptionally high.

I'm still a rookie Trainer.
I have little trust to offer them, let alone reward.

Even so, she hurried everywhere.
From major hospitals all the way to local rural clinics.
"Please, help me support Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. I went everywhere pleading for that wish—"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes~. Trainer.
Oh, come on~ just leave it all to me~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
where are weee~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A Trainer's office at Tracen Academy!?

"...He's a bit quirky,
but he is well-known as a skilled practitioner."
I heard she's qualified as a sports doctor, and has even handled national athletes competing in world championships, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Trainer?
Are you reeeally gonna be okay...?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine. Their skills should be top-notch, so...!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, so this is it~
Tracen Academy's training grounds~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Haaah, so these are woodchips. Seeing them in person, they're about the size of a finger's first knuckle, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: I-It's fine, it's fine! Just go run one lap first!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
*Phew*...

I have Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi run the same routine as up until the other day.
Yesterday, if I remember correctly, she came down with a fever shortly after this—
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, let's get you iced up too

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: And let's disinfect that too, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Disinfection...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Yes... The course is very well maintained, but...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Running at the speed of an Umamusume,
sand and woodchips will inevitably fly up, won't they?
No matter how tiny those particles might be...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there's a micro-abrasion invisible to the naked eye?
The heat in the affected area might be caused by a small wound.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Of course, this might not be
the best way to handle it, but...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Let's check every single thing that caught our interest,
one by one, exhaustively.
Little by little, including things beyond immune issues~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best~.
Tsurumaru-san, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-Yes!!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer!
This teacher...!

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi gave multiple passionate nods,
breathing heavily through her nose.
—With this, we should be one step closer toward the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…………
...My leg doesn't hurt today, either.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...I bought it. I actually bought it!
The Satsuki Sho special feature!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Even if they're only talking about the "Big Three"... On race day, I'll show them too—!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that...
...Tsuru-chan over there?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! A-Ahhh, it's been so long!
We were in the same club class, right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We were in Class B together for a brief moment!
Though I ended up going to a different school in the end~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Are you still chasing that dream, Tsuru-chan?
—The dream of becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! Why, of course!!
Look forward to the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: My allies are... amazing too!!
(Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. May I have a moment~?
choice_data_list: Yes, what can I help you with?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "I decided to get involved with you all as a dedicated physician, and today, I saw that girl with my own eyes."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That is why, for the sake of my resolve,
please allow me to ask one question.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you truly intending to enter
that Tsurumaru in the Satsuki Sho?"
